Re-reviewed 2026-11-19 against GitHub/OSV and PyPI: upstream still has no fixed release; active security audit and 7-day expiry retained. Do not extend again without repository security review.
exceptions.reachability: Repository code search 2026-11-19 found zero LlamaDiskCache / set_cache( usages, zero direct diskcache import usages; only the security exception file mentions diskcache. llama_server cache_type settings are llama.cpp KV cache flags, not python-diskcache. Vulnerability requires attacker-controlled cache files followed by unsafe unpickling; this product does not expose diskcache reading.
compensating_controls: No LlamaDiskCache / set_cache( or direct diskcache APIs exposed in repository runtime code (GitHub code search verified 2026-11-19)
Korgis local-first runtime does not expose a disk cache directory for untrusted write access
Dependency security audit is preserved with exactly this named exception, never disabled
Exception expires within seven days (2026-11-26); remove on upstream fix or on new reachable usage
exceptions.remediation: remove the exception and update the lock as soon as a fixed diskcache release or a llama-cpp-python release without the vulnerable dependency is available
